verdict_reason: Rename-only: the sole diff hunk is the package declaration (address.book -> addressbook); the two pre-existing tests are tautological (isNotNull/isInstanceOf on a compile-time-guaranteed return type) but that is untouched by this PR and MetricsConfig has no @ConditionalOnProperty to cover, so it is logged as Minor.

todos.issue: Both tests are tautological: the declared return types are TimedAspect/CountedAspect, so isNotNull() plus isInstanceOf() can only fail if the factory returns null — nothing asserts the aspect was bound to the supplied MeterRegistry (pre-existing; this PR only changes the package line).
todos.fix: Assert observable behaviour instead — e.g. exercise the aspect against a @Timed/@Counted proxy and assert the SimpleMeterRegistry records the meter, or drop the trivial tests and cover the beans via a @SpringBootTest/ApplicationContextRunner context assertion.
